paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Inner Monologue turns on HotPotQA. The green line represents the Naive Generation baseline, while the blue line shows the performance of SIM-RAGlite. The red line indicates the EM score using the ground-truth label as an Oracle Critic.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of different methods over multiple turns of inner monologue, represented by their Exact Match (EM) percentage. The x-axis is labeled "Turns of Inner Monologue," featuring a linear scale with a range from 0 to 6 at intervals of 1 turn. The y-axis, labeled "EM (%)", is also on a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 50, marked at intervals of 10%. There are three lines in the plot: a red line for "SIM-RAG (Oracle Critic)" using 'x' markers and a solid line style, which starts at around 20% EM at 0 turns and rises steadily to approximately 47% at 6 turns. A blue line for "SIM-RAG (lite)" employs '+' markers with a solid line style, beginning just above 15% EM and increasing steadily to about 30% at 6 turns. Lastly, a green line for "Naive Gen" uses 'x' markers with a solid line style, remaining consistently around 20% EM across all turns from 0 to 6, indicating a steady trend without significant change. A legend is placed at the top center of the plot.
